messages:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — FinTech POC asking for our incident response / breach notify timeline + CAIQ/SIG answers. They want a sample contract clause for the POC. can we provide a standard template?
Ben (Security): We generally do: internal ack within 4 hours, customer notify within 72 hours for data-impacting incidents. regulators depend on jurisdiction (24-72h). For POCs we can offer 72h customer notify and escalate faster if creds/PII exposed. :+1:  
Lina (Legal): 72h is fine for initial customer notice, but need to avoid promising regulator timelines unless contractually agreed per region. Also recommend "as soon as reasonably practicable" language + a 72-hour initial notice. I'll draft a short clause.
Marta (Solutions Eng): FYI differences between hosted vs VPC: hosted = we handle detection/ops + notify; VPC/private = customer ops primarily, we support ops playbook and optional notify assistance. Important to call that out in clause.
Ravi (Prod): We should also call out fallback behavior for Dedicated: if model serving degraded, auto-failover to compatible region/model. Not strictly IR but customers ask about continuity guarantees during incidents.
Sam (AE): Perfect — customer specifically asked: "If we see a compromise, what timeline before Redwood notifies us? Will we get live updates?" Also they asked for CAIQ/consensus answers for incident handling controls.
Ben (Security): I'll attach the CAIQ subset answers (SOC/IR sections). For the timeline question: propose we commit to "initial acknowledgement within 4 hours, substantive update within 24 hours, customer notification within 72 hours" with a clause for exceptions "unless prohibited by law or active law enforcement request".
Lina (Legal): Draft clause (suggested) — paste into the thread: 
```
Incident Notification. Redwood will: (a) acknowledge receipt of a security incident affecting Customer within four (4) hours of detection; (b) provide a substantive update within twenty-four (24) hours describing scope and mitigation steps; and (c) notify the Customer of confirmed customer data compromise within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation. If applicable law requires different timelines or disclosure is restricted by law enforcement, Redwood will comply with legal requirements and notify the Customer as permitted.
```
Ben (Security): Add-on wording for POC: "For Proof-of-Concept engagements, Redwood will provide initial incident context and mitigation guidance; responsibility for full remediation may remain with the Customer depending on deployment mode (Hosted vs VPC)."
Marta (Solutions Eng): Helpful to give them an example cadence for POC comms they can expect during the 72h window. Proposed template: 
```
T+0: internal detection + 4h ack to customer
T+24: substantive update (scope, likely vectors, next steps)
T+48: mitigation progress update
T+72: confirmed notification & recommended remediation (if confirmed).
```
Sam (AE): Can we also include a sample one-page notification email they could send to their counsel/regulators? They asked for that.
Lina (Legal): Short sample below (they can reword): 
"Dear [Customer Counsel], we detected unusual activity affecting a subset of systems. We have engaged Redwood Inference and are working through mitigation. Redwood has committed to initial acknowledgement within 4 hours and will provide updates per agreed cadence. We will share confirmed scope and remediation steps no later than 72 hours after confirmation of data compromise"
Ben (Security): I'll upload the CAIQ answers & a trimmed SIG matrix to the shared drive and link here. Also adding our internal IR playbook link for operations team: https://internal/redwood/ir-playbook (security-only).
Sam (AE): Customer also asked about breach notify for model leak vs customer data leak — different handling?
Ben (Security): Yes. Model leakage (prompts/outputs) => operational incident, mitigations, likely customer notification if outputs contain their secrets. Customer data leak (PII/creds) => immediate priority, controller obligations may apply. Use the same cadence but escalate higher.
Marta (Solutions Eng): For POC contracts we should include a checkbox to indicate deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC) and a short paragraph per mode. I'll draft SOW addendum language.
Lina (Legal): Next steps: I will prepare the short clause + sample notification email + RACI line for POC (who owns remediation). Ben please confirm CAIQ snippets. Marta please add the deployment-mode paragraph. Sam pls confirm customer timezone / regulator jurisdiction so we can tailor.
Sam (AE): Thanks — customer in UK (FCA jurisdiction) and also has US ops. I'll loop them in once we have the draft.
ir-bot: Document created: sales/poc-2024/fintech-ir-resources (internal) — link shared in DM.
Ben (Security): Quick note: do not promise forensic detail in public customer notices — offer to share full forensics under NDA. Lina, flag if needs tweaking.
Lina (Legal): Good catch. We'll add "detailed forensics will be provided under appropriate confidentiality or legal disclosure process" line.
Sam (AE): Great. ETA for full package?
Lina (Legal): EOD tomorrow for clause + sample email.
Ben (Security): I'll have CAIQ snippets and 72h timeline wording by EOD today.
Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll drop the deployment-mode SOW paragraph by EOD today.
Sam (AE): Awesome — will set customer expectation for a follow up call after we send the package. :wave:
